_comment_about_altIds: If an agent changed MLS IDs (e.g. switched brokerages and got a new ID), list the old IDs in altIds — sales are merged under the primary mlsId.
_comment_about_manualSales: For sales MLSPIN doesn't have (e.g. NH deals on NEREN, pre-2018 records under team accounts), add them under manualSales with lat/lng. Use Google Maps to find coordinates — right-click any address, the first item in the menu is the lat/lng.
